name: v1rus-kmp
description: Kotlin Multiplatform layer for v1rus, on top of the shared Compose layer: commonMain constraints and expect/actual discipline, the KMP module graph and source-set rules, the KMP data layer (Room builder and Ktor HttpClient as expect/actual per platform, bearer-token refresh), commonTest conventions with kotlin.test and handwritten fakes, the kmp-pipeline-profile that binds the feature pipeline to a KMP project, plus the swift-engineer and swiftui-developer agents and the KMP test-runner. Compose UI, MVI, Koin and performance rules come from v1rus-compose.
